scripts.build:cloud: esbuild cloud-src/cloud.js cloud-src/pdf.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --outdir=www --external:canvg --external:html2canvas --external:dompurify && node -e "try{const fs=require('fs');fs.mkdirSync('www/pdfjs',{recursive:true});for(const f of ['pdf.min.mjs','pdf.worker.min.mjs'])fs.copyFileSync('node_modules/pdfjs-dist/build/'+f,'www/pdfjs/'+f)}catch(e){console.log('pdfjs non copié',e.message)}"
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:cloud && cap sync android
